g.text: E-304 · magnetic flux and motion constraint
Qualitative field topology; force magnitude comes from the finite-winding calculation.
ON polarity: B points downward near magnet
N remains upward; axial guide prevents flipping
F points upward on selected side of coil center
Coil flux closes through air; no steel return
Reverse current → reverse coil field and force
I=0: no coil field, but the PM field still exists
A steel core adds induced/residual attraction. The air-coil sign symmetry does not transfer automatically to that case.
